name: GARDEN-CONTACT: the along-wall leg runs the full hopper into the garden row — the squeezed balls hold the chassis, the shafts stall, the approach watchdog trips
notes: SG-005 (team ledger 2026-10-10, commit 8ce91a5): the operator saw the robot back into garden balls and stall before firing. Here the shooting spot is set 60 in along the wall so the leg reaches the garden balls with four preloads aboard (the intake cannot take them); loose balls squeezed between chassis and wall refuse the motion (match.pushBalls), the estimated tiles grip stalls the shafts rather than spinning the wheels, and the code's encoder watchdog (< 0.25 in in 1 s) must settle and aim from there. Collision-grounded, not a friction fault; the garden pile itself is the twin's default row, not a measured one.
